title: Change the Telephony stat groups names to reflect their current position
description:
The telephony menu items were originally under Statistics, but were
moved to a top level menu (5375b5f4762c2f7a6ca7aaefac77d955433efe79).
Change the name to reflect that, which also changes the Lua names.

For Lua, enable use of the older, deprecated names, because Lua
scripts are used across versions without recompiling.

Fix #17448
